notes: Sunderland were promoted to the Premier League in 2025; the latest accounts (Sunderland Limited, year to 31 July 2025) cover the 2024/25 Championship season, which is why revenue is £40.3m (the accounts are a scanned PDF at Companies House, so the figures come from FC Business's report of them; the club's own site is script-rendered and not readable). The same report gives gate receipts £13.3m and sponsorship £3.9m but no full revenue split, wages, pre-tax result or net debt; 'overall operating loss of £0.3m' after £45.8m player-trading profit. Stakes come from Off The Pitch (May 2026); Companies House shows Sunderland Limited with no registrable PSC since February 2021. Capacity is the rounded '49,000-capacity' City AM states. No Forbes valuation (not in the top 30, no team page). Kit supplier (hummel) and 2026/27 shirt sponsor not confirmed on a citable page. The Sixth Street/Bay Collective deal is for the women's team only.

ownership_summary: Sunderland is owned through Sunderland Limited (the club company's 75%+ parent, which reports no registrable person with significant control). Kyril Louis-Dreyfus has held 64% since 2023 and Juan Sartori the remaining 36%; Louis-Dreyfus took control from Stewart Donald in February 2021. In May 2026 the owners were reported to be exploring a sale, with Moelis retained; in June 2026 Sixth Street-backed Bay Collective completed the purchase of a majority of Sunderland AFC Women (the club keeps a minority).
revenue_evidence: Sunderland AFC has filed its consolidated accounts for the year ending 31 July 2025 which show the club recorded turnover of £40.3m.
